# Rate Variance Policy

## Why fifteen percent

The rate variance threshold sits at fifteen percent over contract
because smaller drift historically evaporates on review.

## What gets clawed back

When a variance is confirmed, the full delta is clawed back, not just
the portion above the threshold.
